product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an AI-powered privacy automation platform for modern brands and privacy teams to discover and govern personal data, automate privacy requests, and manage compliance.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes a privacy platform serving brands; product pages describe privacy automation and AI governance.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page was found in site navigation or footer; pricing is handled via sales/contact.

named_customers.notes: The page explicitly identifies these as companies DataGrail serves; Salesforce is omitted because it is also an integration/partner.

employee_band.notes: Third-party profile reports a latest employee count of 28 (Tracxn); LinkedIn gives a broad 51-200 range. Using the more specific recent count yields 21-50. https://tracxn.com/d/companies/datagrail/__OHdrdp-73jDqoArxmumnDgw5LVJULSMh4P5Ul33BfaY

hq_location.notes: Company profile gives San Francisco, California as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows largely product/company/marketing material and does not establish at least two qualifying engineering posts; a lone engineering article is insufficient.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation has several articles, integration documentation, changelog and API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board listed roles including Senior Customer Success Manager, IT & Business Systems Manager, Senior Demand Generation Manager, and Senior Product Marketing Manager; no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title appeared.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public docs and searchable AI/product/security materials; no product model provider is specified. References to OpenAI or Anthropic approval do not establish that the product uses those providers.

compliance_certs.notes: DataGrail publicly identifies SOC 2 compliance. GDPR/CCPA are regulations rather than certifications and are not included.

last_funding.notes: DataGrail announced a $45 million Series C on October 12, 2022; research found no later round.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified funding round was announced in October 2022, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board's listed positions did not include SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: August 2026 product updates announced new features, within the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently sourced executive join/departure within 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09 was found. The verified CTO appointment was in 2022, and current public leadership information was checked; no recent change could be confirmed, so the closest defensible result is false based on available public leadership evidence.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations directory identifies Salesforce as a CRM and HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, and Drift as marketing/conversational marketing integrations.
